messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: realtime-latency-detector triggered (p99 > 750ms for 3m). Pager sent to #incidents and oncall. Incident ID: IR-2501 :rotating_light:
sre-omar: seeing the alert, joining. pulling up grafana now — link: https://grafana.redwood/prod/latency/realtime (appending short link).
eng-katie: I can help with quick checks. Is this isolated to a region or global?
sre-omar: early glance looks global but heavier traffic from us-east-1. p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~420ms; p99 ~820ms. Streaming sessions show stalls — many streams stalled after initial tokens.
prod-jared: any customer tickets yet? Support dashboard shows a handful of UX errors (stream timeouts) from two customers on dedicated capacity. Raising priority with CS.
support-lee: I pinged the CS leads, they reported 3 customers seeing partial responses. Escalating them via email.
oncall-maya: taking lead for paging. Omar, can you post the diagnostic checklist you run? I can start handoff after quick triage.
sre-omar: checklist: 1) confirm alerts + scope 2) check recent deploys 3) inspect autoscaler and queue depth 4) examine model runtime errors 5) mitigation (traffic shift / scale / fallback). Running step 2 now.
eng-katie: no prod deploys in last 30m from release bot. I checked deploy bot stream: nothing.
sre-omar: autoscaler logs show a surge of queued requests around T-4m, but nodes did start to spin up. However, startup latency + batching backlog seems to have caused tail blowup.
sre-omar: grabbing runtime logs from a few affected pods. snippet:
```
2025-11-02T14:02:12Z gpu-serve-45 ERROR kvcache: miss spike
2025-11-02T14:02:13Z gpu-serve-45 WARN batcher: queue_length=312 mean_latency=640ms
2025-11-02T14:02:14Z gpu-serve-45 ERROR stream: stall detected after 4 tokens
```
eng-katie: KV-cache misses + big batch queue suggests hot cache eviction or a churn of model variants. Any model rollouts?
sre-omar: checking model catalog events... aha: a gradual rollout of quantized-v2 started ~T-9m for canary group. It shouldn't affect majority but might cause cold cache across nodes.
prod-jared: can we roll that back quickly? If rollout is correlated we should pause and revert.
eng-katie: I can pause the rollout. Doing pause now (ui -> model-rollouts -> pause).
eng-katie: paused. Request: can we trigger immediate traffic rebalancing / start warmup for instances?
sre-omar: initiating warmup script to pre-populate KV caches on new nodes. Running:
```
$ ./infra/warmup.sh --model quantized-v2 --region us-east-1 --parallel 6
```
oncall-maya: I'll notify SRE pager rotation that this is active. Omar, if warmup reduces p99 we can start scaling down aggressive autoscaler rules.
sre-omar: warmup logs: warmup tasks started, populating prefixes. Early telemetry: p95 down to 210ms, p99 down to 430ms (from 820ms). Streaming stall count reduced by ~70% in the warmed shards.
prod-jared: good news. Support, tell impacted customers we're seeing mitigations and will follow up.
support-lee: already messaged the three customers with initial mitigation note and ETA 30m.
eng-katie: for safety I'm deploying a temporary routing policy to divert 20% of traffic to a stable quantized-v1 variant until rollout fully vetted. Patch applied via routing service.
sre-omar: confirmed routing change. effective fallback route to quantized-v1 for 20% of request ID prefixes.
oncall-maya: handoff: I'll stay on until metrics stabilize and then pass to normal rotation. Current action items: continue warmup, monitor p95/p99, validate streaming tails.
sre-omar: adding quick queries for realtime check:
```
# check p95/p99 (last 5m)
SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 95), percentile(latency_ms, 99) FROM api_latency WHERE env='prod' AND minutes=5
```
eng-katie: running regen tests for streaming: starting 50 synthetic streams to affected endpoints to validate stalls are gone.
sre-omar: newest telemetry (T+8m): p95=180ms p99=310ms streaming stall alerts cleared. Queue lengths back to normal.
prod-jared: removing elevated customer impact tag from incident page, but keep monitoring.
support-lee: note for postmortem: customers saw partial responses, correlated with rollout start ~T-9m.
eng-katie: leaving a short remediation note on the model rollout: require warmed cache or staged traffic ramp with pre-warm hooks. Filing PR: https://git.internal/redwood/policies/p1#warm-cache (will reference in postmortem).
oncall-maya: final status: mitigated — p99 back under SLO (target 500ms). Will create incident ticket IR-2501 and assign to eng-katie + sre-omar for follow-up postmortem.
sre-omar: creating the ticket and adding initial timeline + logs.
prod-jared: thanks everyone. follow-ups: 1) postmortem with timeline 2) model rollout gating changes 3) autoscaler warmup tuning.
support-lee: I'll update customer threads with final resolution note in 15m.
eng-katie: quick note: learned that quantized-v2 warmup needed different prefix patterns — adding warmup coverage for stream scenarios.
oncall-maya: handing off to normal oncall. I'll keep the ticket until the postmortem is scheduled. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident IR-2501 acknowledged as MITIGATED by oncall-maya at T+22m.
sre-omar: marking thread resolved here; will follow up in postmortem doc. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
